global_discrepancies: X OpenAPI 2.174 names the post field-selection parameter `post.fields` (PostFieldsParameter) on most endpoints, while docs.x.com/x-api/fundamentals/fields, inline stream parameters in the same spec, and Composio use `tweet.fields`. This server sends `tweet.fields` (documented wire name); unverified against the live API.

X uses pay-per-usage pricing (docs.x.com/x-api/getting-started/pricing): every live call is billable. Official reference pages do not state per-endpoint plan restrictions; Composio descriptions claim Enterprise-only access for some tools (recorded per tool, unverified).
Where Composio and X enums differ (see x_enum per parameter), input validation uses the official X enum.
Composio input `max_results` descriptions advertise automatic multi-page fetching; this server returns a single page and surfaces meta.next_token.

tools.name: TWITTER_CREATE_ACTIVITY_SUBSCRIPTION

tools.name: TWITTER_CREATE_COMPLIANCE_JOB

tools.name: TWITTER_CREATE_DM_CONVERSATION

REQUIRED PARAMETERS: - conversation_type: Must be 'Group' - participant_ids: List of Twitter user IDs to include in the conversation - message: JSON object with the initial message. Must contain 'text' field. To include media attachments, use message.attachments array with media_id (NOT media_url): {"text": "...", "attachments": [{"media_id": "1234567890"}]} Note: Media must be uploaded first using the upload_media action to obtain a media_id.

tools.name: TWITTER_CREATE_LIST
tools.title: Create a list
tools.composio_description: Creates a new, empty List on X (formerly Twitter), for which the provided name must be unique for the authenticated user; accounts are added separately.

tools.name: TWITTER_CREATION_OF_A_POST
tools.title: Create a post

tools.name: TWITTER_DELETE_DM
tools.title: Delete direct message
tools.composio_description: Permanently deletes a specific Twitter Direct Message (DM) event using its `event_id` if the authenticated user sent it; this action is irreversible and does not delete entire conversations.

tools.name: TWITTER_DELETE_LIST
tools.title: Delete list
tools.composio_description: Permanently deletes a specified Twitter List using its ID, which must be owned by the authenticated user; this action is irreversible and the list must already exist.

tools.name: TWITTER_FOLLOWERS_BY_USER_ID
tools.title: Get followers by user id
tools.composio_description: Retrieves a list of users who follow a specified public Twitter user ID.

tools.name: TWITTER_FOLLOWING_BY_USER_ID
tools.title: Get following by user ID
tools.composio_description: Retrieves users followed by a specific Twitter user, allowing pagination and customization of returned user and tweet data fields via expansions.

tools.name: TWITTER_FOLLOW_LIST
tools.title: Follow a list
tools.composio_description: Allows the authenticated user (`id`) to follow a specific Twitter List (`list_id`) they are permitted to access, subscribing them to the list's timeline; this does not automatically follow individual list members.

tools.name: TWITTER_FOLLOW_USER
tools.title: Follow a user
notes: `id` optional: resolved via GET /2/users/me when omitted.
tools.composio_description: Allows an authenticated user (path `id`) to follow another user (`target_user_id`), which results in a pending request if the target user's tweets are protected.

tools.name: TWITTER_FULL_ARCHIVE_SEARCH
tools.title: Search full archive of tweets
notes: Composio auto-paginates; this server returns one page and validates X bounds (10-500, per docs.x.com rate-limit page).
tools.composio_description: Searches the full archive of public Tweets from March 2006 onwards, with optional time bounds. Search queries are normalized, and parseable time bounds outside the supported range are adjusted.

tools.name: TWITTER_GET_BLOCKED_USERS
tools.title: Get users blocked by user ID
tools.composio_description: Retrieves the authenticated user's own block list. IMPORTANT: You can only retrieve YOUR OWN block list - the `id` parameter must be the authenticated user's ID. Use the 'Get authenticated user' action first to obtain your user ID.

tools.name: TWITTER_GET_COMPLIANCE_JOB
tools.title: Retrieve compliance job by id
tools.composio_description: Retrieves status, download/upload URLs, and other details for an existing Twitter compliance job specified by its unique ID.

tools.name: TWITTER_GET_COMPLIANCE_JOBS
tools.title: Retrieve compliance jobs
notes: Composio status enum includes `expired`, which is absent from the X spec enum; it is rejected locally.
tools.composio_description: Returns a list of recent compliance jobs, filtered by type (tweets or users) and optionally by status.

tools.name: TWITTER_GET_DM_CONVERSATION_EVENTS
tools.title: Get DM events for a DM conversation
tools.composio_description: Fetches Direct Message (DM) events for a one-on-one conversation with a specified participant ID, ordered chronologically newest to oldest; does not support group DMs.

tools.name: TWITTER_GET_DM_EVENT
tools.title: Get DM events by ID
tools.composio_description: Fetches a specific Direct Message event by ID, with optional related-data expansions. The response model retains expanded tweets but not expanded users.

tools.name: TWITTER_GET_LIST
tools.title: Lookup list by ID
tools.composio_description: Returns metadata for a specific Twitter List, identified by its ID; does not return list members but can expand the owner's User object via the `expansions` parameter.

tools.name: TWITTER_GET_LIST_FOLLOWERS
tools.title: Get list followers
tools.composio_description: Fetches a list of users who follow a specific Twitter List, identified by its ID; ensure the authenticated user has access if the list is private.

tools.name: TWITTER_GET_LIST_MEMBERS
tools.title: Fetch list members by id
tools.composio_description: Fetches members of a specific Twitter List, identified by its unique ID.

tools.name: TWITTER_GET_MEDIA_UPLOAD_STATUS
tools.title: Get Media Upload Status
notes: Sends command=STATUS.
tools.composio_description: Get the processing status of uploaded media (videos/GIFs) on X/Twitter. Only call this when the FINALIZE command returned a processing_info field. Poll every 3–5 seconds with a 60–120 second maximum timeout to avoid HTTP 429 errors. Response state cycles through 'pending', 'in_progress', 'succeeded', and 'failed'. Only attach media_id to a tweet when state is 'succeeded'. State 'failed' is terminal — requires a completely new upload via TWITTER_UPLOAD_MEDIA or TWITTER_UPLOAD_LARGE_MEDIA. Video/GIF processing takes 30–120 seconds; posting before 'succeeded' results in non-playable media.

tools.name: TWITTER_GET_MUTED_USERS
tools.title: Get muted users
tools.composio_description: Returns user objects muted by the X user identified by the `id` path parameter.

tools.name: TWITTER_GET_OPENAPI_SPEC
tools.title: Fetch OpenAPI specification
notes: Unauthenticated; returns a large (~1.3 MB) document.
tools.composio_description:
Fetches the OpenAPI specification (JSON) for Twitter's API v2, used to programmatically understand the API's structure for developing client libraries or tools.

#### Output

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `data` | string | Yes | Data from the action execution |
| `error` | string | No | Error if any occurred during the execution of the action |
| `successful` | boolean | Yes | Whether or not the action execution was successful or not |

tools.name: TWITTER_GET_POST_ANALYTICS
tools.title: Get Post analytics
notes: Composio states an Enterprise plan is required (403 otherwise). docs.x.com reference does not state a plan restriction; unverified live.
tools.composio_description: Tool to retrieve analytics data for specified Posts within a defined time range. Use when you need engagement metrics, impressions, or other analytics for one or more Posts. Requires OAuth 2.0 with tweet.read and users.read scopes. Requires an X Enterprise API plan. Accounts on Free, Basic, Pro, or Pay-Per-Use tiers will receive a 403 Forbidden on every call, regardless of scopes or request correctness - this is not something a connected account's OAuth grant can unlock.

tools.name: TWITTER_GET_POST_RETWEETERS_ACTION
tools.title: Get post retweeters
tools.composio_description: Retrieves users who publicly retweeted a specified public Post ID, excluding Quote Tweets and retweets from private accounts.

tools.name: TWITTER_GET_POST_RETWEETS
tools.title: Retrieve retweets of a post
tools.composio_description: Retrieves Tweets that Retweeted a specified public or authenticated-user-accessible Tweet ID, optionally customizing the response with fields and expansions.

tools.name: TWITTER_GET_POST_USAGE
tools.title: Fetch tweet usage data
notes: App-only bearer token required.
tools.composio_description: Fetches Tweet usage statistics for a Project (e.g., consumption, caps, daily breakdowns for Project & Client Apps) to monitor API limits; data can be retrieved for 1 to 90 days.

tools.name: TWITTER_GET_RECENT_DM_EVENTS
tools.title: Get recent direct message events
tools.composio_description: Returns recent Direct Message events for the authenticated user, such as new messages or changes in conversation participants.

tools.name: TWITTER_GET_SPACES_BY_CREATORS
tools.title: Get spaces by creator IDs
tools.composio_description: Retrieves Twitter Spaces created by a list of specified User IDs, with options to customize returned data fields.

tools.name: TWITTER_GET_SPACES_BY_IDS
tools.title: Get space information by IDs
tools.composio_description: Fetches detailed information for one or more Twitter Spaces (live, scheduled, or ended) by their unique IDs; at least one Space ID must be provided.

tools.name: TWITTER_GET_SPACE_BY_ID
tools.title: Look up space by ID
tools.composio_description: Retrieves details for a Twitter Space by its ID, allowing for customization and expansion of related data, provided the Space ID is valid and accessible.

tools.name: TWITTER_GET_SPACE_POSTS
tools.title: Retrieve posts from a space
tools.composio_description: Retrieves Tweets that were shared/posted during a Twitter Space broadcast. IMPORTANT: This endpoint returns Tweets that participants explicitly shared during the Space session, NOT audio transcripts, comments, or reactions. Most Spaces have zero associated Tweets, so empty results (result_count=0) are normal and expected. Twitter Spaces are primarily audio conversations - this endpoint only returns text Tweets that were shared alongside the audio.

tools.name: TWITTER_GET_SPACE_TICKET_BUYERS
tools.title: Fetch space ticket buyers list
tools.composio_description: Retrieves a list of users who purchased tickets for a specific, valid, and ticketed Twitter Space.

tools.name: TWITTER_GET_USERS_BY_IDS
tools.title: Look up users by IDs
tools.composio_description: Retrieves detailed information for specified X (formerly Twitter) user IDs, optionally customizing returned fields and expanding related entities.

tools.name: TWITTER_GET_USER_BY_ID
tools.title: Look up user by ID
tools.composio_description: Retrieves detailed public information for a Twitter user by their ID, optionally expanding related data (e.g., pinned tweets) and specifying particular user or tweet fields to return.

tools.name: TWITTER_GET_USER_FOLLOWED_LISTS
tools.title: Get user's followed lists
tools.composio_description: Returns metadata (not Tweets) for lists a specific Twitter user follows, optionally including expanded owner details.

tools.name: TWITTER_GET_USER_LIST_MEMBERSHIPS
tools.title: Get a user's list memberships
tools.composio_description: Retrieves a page of Twitter Lists a specified user is a member of, including public Lists and private Lists the authenticated user is authorized to view. Use the returned pagination token to retrieve further pages.

tools.name: TWITTER_GET_USER_MENTIONS
tools.title: Get user mentions
tools.composio_description: Retrieves one page of posts that mention a selected X user.

tools.name: TWITTER_GET_USER_OWNED_LISTS
tools.title: Get a user's owned lists
tools.composio_description: Call this action to retrieve Lists created (owned) by a specific Twitter user, not Lists they follow or are subscribed to.

tools.name: TWITTER_GET_USER_PINNED_LISTS
tools.title: Get a user's pinned lists
tools.composio_description: Retrieves the Lists a specific, existing Twitter user has pinned to their profile to highlight them.

tools.name: TWITTER_GET_USER_POSTS
tools.title: Get user posts
tools.composio_description: Retrieves posts authored by a selected X user.

tools.name: TWITTER_GET_USER_PUBLIC_KEYS
tools.title: Get user public keys
notes: X also exposes batch GET /2/users/public_keys; Composio requires a single id so /2/users/{id}/public_keys is used.
tools.composio_description: Returns an X user's registered public keys for X Chat encryption.

tools.name: TWITTER_HIDE_REPLIES
tools.title: Set reply visibility
tools.composio_description: Hides or unhides an existing reply Tweet. This action allows the authenticated user to hide or unhide a reply to a conversation they own (started). You can only hide replies to posts you authored. Note: Requires the tweet.moderate.write OAuth scope.

tools.name: TWITTER_INITIALIZE_MEDIA_UPLOAD
tools.title: Initialize Media Upload
notes: Composio has no FINALIZE tool, so INITIALIZE/APPEND alone cannot complete an upload. This server adds extra tool X_FINALIZE_MEDIA_UPLOAD (finalizeMediaUpload); it is not counted toward Composio coverage.
tools.composio_description: Initialize a media upload session for X/Twitter. Use this to start a chunked media upload process, which returns a media_id for subsequent APPEND and FINALIZE commands. Required for uploading large files or when using the chunked upload workflow.

tools.name: TWITTER_LIST_CHAT_CONVERSATIONS
tools.title: List chat conversations
notes: X exposes extra filters (is_archived, is_muted, participant_ids, participant_query, start_time, end_time, type, unread_only); not exposed (outside Composio baseline).
tools.composio_description: Lists one page of X Chat conversations in the authenticated user's inbox.

tools.name: TWITTER_LIST_POSTS_TIMELINE_BY_LIST_ID
tools.title: List posts timeline by list ID
tools.composio_description: Fetches the most recent Tweets posted by members of a specified Twitter List.

tools.name: TWITTER_LIST_POST_LIKERS
tools.title: List post likers
tools.composio_description: Retrieves users who have liked the Post (Tweet) identified by the provided ID.

tools.name: TWITTER_MUTE_USER
tools.title: Mute user by ID
notes: `id` optional: resolved via GET /2/users/me when omitted.
tools.composio_description: Mutes a target user on behalf of an authenticated user, preventing the target's Tweets and Retweets from appearing in the authenticated user's home timeline without notifying the target.

tools.name: TWITTER_PIN_LIST
tools.title: Pin a list
tools.composio_description: Pins a specified List to the authenticated user's profile, provided the List exists, the user has access rights, and the pin limit (typically 5 Lists) is not exceeded.

tools.name: TWITTER_POST_DELETE_BY_POST_ID
tools.title: Delete tweet
tools.composio_description: Irreversibly deletes a specific Tweet by its ID; the Tweet may persist in third-party caches after deletion.

tools.name: TWITTER_POST_LOOKUP_BY_POST_ID
tools.title: Look up post by id
tools.composio_description: Fetches comprehensive details for a single Tweet by its unique ID, provided the Tweet exists and is accessible.

tools.name: TWITTER_POST_LOOKUP_BY_POST_IDS
tools.title: Get tweets by IDs
tools.composio_description: Retrieves detailed information for one or more Posts (Tweets) identified by their unique IDs, allowing selection of specific fields and expansions.

tools.name: TWITTER_RECENT_SEARCH
tools.title: Search recent tweets
notes: Composio auto-paginates max_results up to 2000; this server returns one page and validates X bounds (10-100). Continue with meta.next_token.
tools.composio_description: Searches Tweets from the last seven days using X query syntax, with optional fields, expansions, sorting, and time or ID bounds. Timestamp and ID bounds cannot be combined in the same request. Requests for more than 100 results are automatically paginated up to 2,000; use the returned next token to continue when more results are available.

tools.name: TWITTER_REMOVE_LIST_MEMBER
tools.title: Remove a list member
tools.composio_description: Removes a user from a Twitter List; the response `is_member` field will be `false` if removal was successful or the user was not a member, and the updated list of members is not returned.

tools.name: TWITTER_REMOVE_POST_FROM_BOOKMARKS
tools.title: Remove a bookmarked post
notes: `id` optional: resolved via GET /2/users/me when omitted.
tools.composio_description: Removes a Tweet, specified by `tweet_id`, from the authenticated user's bookmarks; the Tweet must have been previously bookmarked by the user for the action to have an effect.

tools.name: TWITTER_RETRIEVE_DM_CONVERSATION_EVENTS
tools.title: Retrieve DM conversation events
tools.composio_description: Retrieves Direct Message (DM) events for a specific conversation ID on Twitter, useful for analyzing messages and participant activities.

tools.name: TWITTER_RETRIEVE_POSTS_THAT_QUOTE_A_POST
tools.title: Retrieve posts that quote a post
tools.composio_description: Retrieves Tweets that quote a specified Tweet, requiring a valid Tweet ID.

tools.name: TWITTER_RETURNS_POST_OBJECTS_LIKED_BY_THE_PROVIDED_USER_ID
tools.title: Retrieve liked tweets by user ID
tools.composio_description: Retrieves Tweets liked by a specified Twitter user, provided their liked tweets are public or accessible.

tools.name: TWITTER_RETWEET_POST
tools.title: Retweet post
notes: No user id parameter in Composio: path id resolved via GET /2/users/me.
tools.composio_description: Retweets a Tweet for the authenticated user. The user ID is automatically fetched from the authenticated session - you only need to provide the tweet_id to retweet.

tools.name: TWITTER_SEARCH_FULL_ARCHIVE_COUNTS
tools.title: Get full archive search counts
tools.composio_description: Returns a count of Tweets from the full archive that match a specified query, aggregated by day, hour, or minute; `start_time` must be before `end_time` if both are provided, and `since_id`/`until_id` cannot be used with `start_time`/`end_time`.

tools.name: TWITTER_SEARCH_NEWS
tools.title: Search X news
tools.composio_description: Searches X for AI-generated news stories matching text.

tools.name: TWITTER_SEARCH_RECENT_COUNTS
tools.title: Fetch recent tweet counts
tools.composio_description: Retrieves the count of Tweets matching a specified search query within the last 7 days, aggregated by 'minute', 'hour', or 'day'.

tools.name: TWITTER_SEARCH_SPACES
tools.title: Search for spaces
tools.composio_description: Searches for Twitter Spaces by a textual query, optionally filtering by state (live, scheduled, all) to discover audio conversations.

tools.name: TWITTER_SEND_A_NEW_MESSAGE_TO_A_USER
tools.title: Send a new message to a user
tools.composio_description: Sends a new Direct Message with text and/or media (media_id for attachments must be pre-uploaded) to a specified Twitter user; this creates a new DM and does not modify existing messages.

tools.name: TWITTER_SEND_DM_TO_CONVERSATION
tools.title: Send a new message to a DM conversation
tools.composio_description: Sends a message, with optional text and/or media attachments (using pre-uploaded `media_id`s), to a specified Twitter Direct Message conversation.

tools.name: TWITTER_STREAM_POST_LABELS
tools.title: Get tweets label stream
notes: Streaming endpoint: the tool reads a bounded window (max_events / timeout_seconds extensions) and then closes the connection. Composio states Enterprise access + app-only auth is required.
tools.composio_description: Stream real-time Tweet label events (apply/remove). Requires Enterprise access and App-Only OAuth 2.0 auth. Returns PublicTweetNotice or PublicTweetUnviewable events. 403 errors indicate missing Enterprise access or wrong auth type.

tools.name: TWITTER_UNFOLLOW_LIST
tools.title: Unfollow a list
tools.composio_description: Enables a user (via `id`) to unfollow a specific Twitter List (via `list_id`), which removes its tweets from their timeline and stops related notifications; the action reports `following: false` on success, even if the user was not initially following the list.

tools.name: TWITTER_UNFOLLOW_USER
tools.title: Unfollow user
notes: `source_user_id` optional: resolved via GET /2/users/me when omitted.
tools.composio_description: Allows the authenticated user to unfollow an existing Twitter user (`target_user_id`), which removes the follow relationship. The source user ID is automatically determined from the authenticated session.

tools.name: TWITTER_UNLIKE_POST
tools.title: Unlike post
tools.composio_description: Allows an authenticated user (`id`) to remove their like from a specific post (`tweet_id`); the action is idempotent and completes successfully even if the post was not liked.

tools.name: TWITTER_UNMUTE_USER
tools.title: Unmute a user by user ID
notes: No source user parameter in Composio: source_user_id resolved via GET /2/users/me.
tools.composio_description: Unmutes a target user for the authenticated user, allowing them to see Tweets and notifications from the target user again. The source_user_id is automatically populated from the authenticated user's credentials.

tools.name: TWITTER_UNPIN_LIST
tools.title: Unpin a list
notes: `id` optional: resolved via GET /2/users/me when omitted.
tools.composio_description: Unpins a List (specified by list_id) from the authenticated user's profile. The user ID is automatically retrieved if not provided.

tools.name: TWITTER_UNRETWEET_POST
tools.title: Unretweet post
notes: `id` optional: resolved via GET /2/users/me when omitted.
tools.composio_description: Removes a user's retweet of a specified Post, if the user had previously retweeted it.

tools.name: TWITTER_UPDATE_LIST

tools.composio_description: Updates an existing Twitter List's name, description, or privacy status, requiring the List ID and at least one mutable property.

tools.name: TWITTER_UPLOAD_LARGE_MEDIA
tools.title: Upload Large Media

params.note: Read locally, then INITIALIZE (media_type,total_bytes) -> APPEND chunks (base64, segment_index) -> FINALIZE -> poll STATUS.

notes: Composite operation; no automatic retry of APPEND/FINALIZE.

params.note: Composio file object replaced by {base64|path, mime_type, filename}; bytes are sent base64-encoded in a JSON body.

tools.name: TWITTER_USER_HOME_TIMELINE_BY_USER_ID
tools.title: Get user reverse chronological timeline
notes: `id` optional: resolved via GET /2/users/me when omitted.

The user ID is fetched automatically when omitted; a supplied ID that differs from the authenticated user's ID is replaced with the authenticated ID.

tools.name: TWITTER_USER_LIKE_POST

tools.name: TWITTER_USER_LOOKUP_BY_USERNAME

tools.name: TWITTER_USER_LOOKUP_BY_USERNAMES

tools.composio_description: Retrieves detailed information for 1 to 100 Twitter users by their usernames (each 1-15 alphanumeric characters/underscores), allowing customizable user/tweet fields and expansion of related data like pinned tweets.

tools.name: TWITTER_USER_LOOKUP_ME
tools.title: Get authenticated user
tools.composio_description: Returns profile information for the currently authenticated X user, customizable via request fields.
